items.change: 2x2 panels; gradient bulge, disk, twin spiral arms, bar; part tabs and panel focus; per-panel presence line; E drawn as one ellipsoid system without a separate bulge/disk decomposition; arms described as disk spiral structure with density wave as one interpretation.

Comoving rows keep identical ticks; separate physical-separation panel with bars, a_e chi0 vs chi0 and a x2 bracket; angle-size and flux definition panels; three-distance panel at z=1; a_e slider with reset.
Past light cone of today drawn as two arrows plus a faint causal region; horizons restyled thin; future/past labels; one light-cone legend entry.
Three principal-plane contours distinguished by solid/dashed/dotted strokes; a/b/c axis labels with the compressed axis marked; stage titles state which axis is compressed.
Time slider 0.50-0.75 with before/at/after presets; current points on the curves; rings plus a fixed 0-1.3 r0 radius ruler; analytic crossing times and radial order in the readout.
theta_E reference circle is a stroke-only dashed circle (no fill); sky panel is two-dimensional with axes, lens centre, source and two images at the computed angles.
One isodensity level at a time (m=0.5/1/1.5); upper panel draws only that level's three principal contours; lower z=0 cross-sections linked by a bold line; a/b/c triad.

Radial layers drawn as bounded regions with leaders in both panels; layer tabs dim the other layers; Sedov keeps only shock and heated interior (no invented inner shell); wind inner radii labelled schematic; t^0.4 / t^0.6 stated.
Framing boxes and view arrows A to B to C labelled as framing only, with no magnification factor and no invented units.

Declared teaching optical-depth model: dust tau=tau0*0.15um/lambda; H2 seven schematic lines with sigma=0.7nm; incident/transmitted spectra with the absorbed area; tau0 and lambda sliders, presets and a wavelength marker; the axis is labelled ultraviolet teaching band.

Chapter-2 H-R axes, temperature colour ramp and log L axis reused; mass markers on the MS with on/off status from the lifetime fit; turnoff marker and mass curve from the same fit; single-star MS stage bar with an uncomputed post-MS region; age slider and mass tabs.
Inflow arrows reach the disk edge; the stellar body, disk gas, tail and P_ram are labelled; the tide axis is stated to be position not time; no fake axes on the conceptual panel.
Satellite, background particles, wake boundary, velocity and response force are separated semantically; optional dashed deflection paths are clamped to the panel width and labelled as schematic.

Wireframe box and plane replace the filled bf-faint polylines; points coloured by the third variable i; slice slider; one click or arrow key marks the same synthetic point in both projections; the keyboard entry is pointer-transparent and keeps focus across redraws.
Reused integration samples with per-sample Lz; time slider draws the traversed segment, a direction arrow and the current Lz with its sign and range; no re-integration.

Spatial cross-section replaces the four text rows: black hole, thin disk, BLR clouds, two torus lobes, bipolar NLR cones and an optional jet; an inclination slider draws the sight line and marks torus blocking from the drawn aspect ratio; component tabs.
Pair chords use a visible series stroke; each panel states its total pair count; per-halo N and the occupancy contrast are labelled.

Shared probe in both panels; pointer hit-tests x and y against each real plot frame (right panel included); one writer keeps figure marks, slider, output and readout in sync; keyboard arrows/Home/End; endpoint label folds back inside the SVG.

Forest, LLS and DLA drawn as nested bands on one column-density axis with the DLA dashed outline inside the LLS band and labels placed in their own regions; the inclusion relation is preserved, not turned into exclusive classes.
